authorized_title: Controller-Free Architectural Room Authoring in VR Using Markerless MediaPipe Hand Tracking and Gesture-Driven Interaction
research_question: How do first-time users experience building three-dimensional architectural structures (rooms) in VR using bare-hand gestures alone, in terms of perceived usability, workload and interaction breakdowns?
previous_title: How can an OpenCV-based color and fiducial hand-tracking pipeline integrated with Unity VR achieve sub-15ms latency and gesture recognition accuracy for architectural 3D model reviews without dedicated 6-DoF controllers?
title_change_note: Topic changed from colour-marker/fiducial tracking to markerless hand tracking; change approved by course faculty.
